D1.summary: On the hosted platform public.entitlement_grants is created by the baseline applier identity `postgres`, and the platform's pg_default_acl (reproduced and measured by the opening; re-affirmed for service_role by db/migrations/0033_public_api_grants.sql lines 12-13) grants `authenticated` and `service_role` ALL (arwdDxtm) on every table `postgres` creates in schema public. `anon` holds nothing because 0033 line 8 revokes its default. db/migrations/0073 does not revoke these inherited grants: it ENABLEs and FORCEs RLS (lines 95-96), creates exactly one SELECT policy TO uellix_owner (lines 114-117), GRANTs SELECT to uellix_owner (line 129), and installs an append-only trigger that is BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ... FOR EACH ROW (lines 356-359). TRUNCATE is subject to neither row-level security nor a FOR EACH ROW trigger. A tenant-reachable role can therefore empty the entire relation, which contradicts the parent's ENTITLEMENT_GRANT.target_shape.append_only_rule ('No other UPDATE and no DELETE'), SEC-12 ('History remains reconstructible ... from append-only rows'), and the node authority's SC-6 and append_only_mutation_restriction, whose storage-boundary requirement is BINDING.
frozen_clauses_contradicted: COMMERCIAL_ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENT_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json ENTITLEMENT_GRANT.target_shape.append_only_rule (verbatim): "Rows are INSERTed and CLOSED (effective_to set once, from NULL to a timestamp). No other UPDATE and no DELETE. Revocation is closing the live row, optionally followed by inserting a replacement. A 'status' column is deliberately ABSENT: status is derived from the effective period, so a row cannot be simultaneously closed and active."

COMMERCIAL_ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENT_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json SECURITY_CONTROLS SEC-12 (verbatim control text): "History remains reconstructible. For any Organization and any past instant, the governing CommercialAccount and the live grants are answerable from append-only rows, with no reliance on a mutable current value."

COMMERCIAL_ACCOUNT_CE3_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json RLS_SECURITY_CONTRACT.append_only_mutation_restriction.rule (verbatim): "The storage boundary must REFUSE any UPDATE other than the single NULL -> timestamp transition of effective_to, and must refuse every DELETE." -- with its measured_mechanisms_available naming 'a revoked privilege' as an admissible mechanism and its existence AT THE STORAGE BOUNDARY as BINDING.
D1.why_TRUNCATE_is_inside_the_frozen_contra: A TRUNCATE is the deletion of every row without a DELETE statement. The frozen contract forbids the OUTCOME (history destroyed) and locates the guard at the STORAGE BOUNDARY. A boundary that refuses DELETE row by row while admitting TRUNCATE has a guard on the verb and not on the boundary.

D2.summary: service_role is a platform role that carries BYPASSRLS on the hosted platform (and is created NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS by the CE-3 fixture itself, tests/postgres/ce3-entitlement-grants-fixtures.ts line 138 at PR #159 head). Under the hosted default privileges it holds ALL on public.entitlement_grants, and under the platform's function defaults it holds EXECUTE on public.entitlement_effective(uuid,varchar). The opening measured service_role reading every row of the relation including the sibling-organization canary. No frozen CE-3 authority classifies service_role: the ONLY frozen mention is v1.0.1's node-level PRE-12, which lists it among the roles no tenant-facing policy may be addressed to. Whether a BYPASSRLS platform role may hold a DIRECT privilege on the relation was never adjudicated, and an unadjudicated privilege is a gap, not a permission.

A correctly owned evaluator reading through a live FORCE RLS policy protects only the reads that go THROUGH the evaluator. A tenant-reachable role holding a DIRECT privilege on the relation does not go through the evaluator: with direct TRUNCATE it destroys the history SEC-12 depends on; with direct INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE it makes the grant a tenant-writable fact, which dissolves SEC-3 and SEC-4 (an entitlement the tenant can write is not a decision the platform made); and a BYPASSRLS role with direct SELECT answers a cross-organization question SEC-6 requires to be REFUSED, without any evaluator being consulted.
I__SECURITY_CONTROLS_ENFORCEABILITY_PREM.the_required_property_added: On public.entitlement_grants NO tenant-reachable role and NO BYPASSRLS platform role holds ANY direct privilege, and the ONLY non-owner direct privilege on the relation is SELECT held by uellix_owner. On public.entitlement_effective(uuid,varchar) the ONLY non-owner EXECUTE is held by authenticated. Both are frozen as exact closed contracts in the node amendment v1.0.2 (TABLE_ACL_CONTRACT, FUNCTION_EXECUTE_CONTRACT) and are summarised in TARGET_ACL_CONTRACT_AUTHORIZED below.
I__SECURITY_CONTROLS_ENFORCEABILITY_PREM.no_alternative_is_admitted: There is no 'or RLS is enough', no 'or the trigger covers it', no 'or service_role is trusted' reading of this clause. RLS does not apply to TRUNCATE. A FOR EACH ROW trigger does not fire on TRUNCATE. A BYPASSRLS role is not subject to any policy. Each of those three facts is a PostgreSQL semantic, not an implementation choice.

TARGET_ACL_CONTRACT_AUTHORIZED.classification: PARENT-LEVEL AUTHORIZATION of the closed contract the hosted0010 unit may act against. The BEHAVIOUR (preconditions, postconditions, grantor doctrine, refusals) is frozen in the node amendment v1.0.2 TABLE_ACL_CONTRACT and FUNCTION_EXECUTE_CONTRACT, which MUST be deep-equal to the two maps below. A divergence between the two documents is a defect of whichever was written second, and the act STOPS.
TARGET_ACL_CONTRACT_AUTHORIZED.expressed_relative_to_the_owner: PostgreSQL grants the object OWNER every privilege implicitly, and ALTER ... OWNER TO rewrites the owner's implicit ACL entry and the grantor of every other entry. A raw relacl / proacl literal is therefore substrate-dependent and is NEVER frozen here. What is frozen is the set of NON-OWNER (grantee, privilege) pairs, and the identity of the owner is a MEASURED fact of the substrate.

TABLE.any_other_non_owner_grantee: REFUSED unless explicitly frozen by a later authority amendment. PUBLIC included.
TABLE.owner: IMPLICIT OWNER CAPABILITY, measured from pg_class.relowner, never assumed. On the hosted platform the owner is the baseline applier `postgres`; on a fixture-shaped substrate it may be uellix_owner. The contract holds in both because it is stated over NON-owner grantees.
TABLE.ADMINISTRATIVE_RESIDUAL: The owner's implicit TRUNCATE (and every other owner power) is named ADMINISTRATIVE_RESIDUAL. It is NOT a tenant permission and NOT a runtime permission. It is acceptable ONLY because NO Commercial V1 request path can execute as the owner or as the baseline applier: db/safety/database-role.ts FORBIDDEN_RUNTIME_DATABASE_ROLES forbids postgres, supabase_admin, service_role, authenticator, uellix_owner and uellix_migrator as runtime connection identities, RUNTIME_DATABASE_ROLE is uellix_app, and B0-14 requires SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY absent. That requirement is BINDING and is re-stated in the node amendment as a precondition of the contract's meaning, not merely of the package.

FUNCTION.owner: uellix_owner, implicit owner capability (after hosted0009), not a separate direct-grant requirement.
FUNCTION.body_signature_definer_search_path: UNCHANGED. hosted0010 may REVOKE unwanted non-owner EXECUTE grants and may do nothing else to the function.

SERVICE_ROLE_CLASSIFICATION.scope: For the Commercial V1 CE-3 runtime, over EXACTLY public.entitlement_grants and public.entitlement_effective(uuid,varchar). This clause does NOT redefine service_role for any other table or function, does NOT edit db/migrations/0033_public_api_grants.sql, and does NOT adjudicate the platform-wide ALL grant 0033 line 12-13 confers on other relations.
recorded_facts: service_role is BYPASSRLS on the hosted platform (pg_roles.rolbypassrls = true), and the CE-3 fixture itself creates it NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS (tests/postgres/ce3-entitlement-grants-fixtures.ts line 138 at 7c178862).

Repository runtime identity controls forbid it from normal application runtime: db/safety/database-role.ts FORBIDDEN_RUNTIME_DATABASE_ROLES contains 'service_role'; db/hosted/baseline-postconditions.ts B0-14-no-service-role-key requires SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to be absent from every environment pointing at the database.

No current Commercial V1 consumer requires direct entitlement_grants access as service_role: app/** and lib/** at BASE_SHA contain zero runtime references to service_role (the single textual hit is a test file under app/actions/grounding/__tests__/).

Therefore the broad 0033 / platform-default privileges are NOT inherited for this relation or this function: public.entitlement_grants and public.entitlement_effective(uuid,varchar) are an EXPLICIT LEAST-PRIVILEGE EXCEPTION, enforced by REVOKE inside hosted0010.

The classification is CONSISTENT with v1.0.1 node PRE-12, which lists service_role among the roles no tenant-facing policy may be addressed to: after hosted0010 service_role holds neither a policy nor a privilege on the relation. OWNER TO re-attributes every non-owner EXECUTE grant to the new owner as grantor; a REVOKE of anon / service_role EXECUTE issued before the transfer would be undone in attribution and could be re-created by nothing, whereas issued after it the grantor is uellix_owner and the REVOKE is measurable and stable.

Repository-native precedent: db/prepared/stella_hosted_0007_runtime_table_acl_contract.sql §4 (SET LOCAL ROLE uellix_owner; GRANT ...; RESET ROLE;). The unit may NOT grant itself any capability, membership or privilege in order to make a SET ROLE succeed.

FORWARD_ONLY_CONTRACT_0010.required_rationale_class: The only reversal of a REVOKE is a GRANT. Re-granting authenticated ALL on entitlement_grants recreates the state in which a tenant role can TRUNCATE the append-only history (D1); re-granting service_role ALL recreates the state in which a BYPASSRLS platform role reads every organization's grants directly (D2); re-granting anon / service_role EXECUTE on the evaluator reopens an execution surface no consumer needs. A rollback script here would be one whose only effect is to reopen the security defects the package closes.
